definitions.explanation: A general term for any business that serves food and beverages to customers. Encompasses restaurants, cafes, bars, and similar establishments. Composed of 飲食 (eating and drinking) + 店 (shop).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲食店|いんしょくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many restaurants on this street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{飲食店|いんしょくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new eatery opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {飲食店|いんしょくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{衛生|えいせい}{管理|かんり}→衛生管理：17986_eiseikanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Hygiene management is essential for running a food-and-drink establishment.

notes:
USAGE:
{飲食店|いんしょくてん} is a broad, somewhat formal term covering any establishment that serves food and drinks. It is commonly used in official, business, and news contexts rather than casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲食店|いんしょくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to run a restaurant)
- {飲食店|いんしょくてん}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (restaurant business)
- {飲食店|いんしょくてん}{街|がい} (restaurant district)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧ is the common loanword for restaurant. ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ refers to a dining hall or casual eatery. {飲食店|いんしょくてん} is the broadest category and is often used in administrative or regulatory contexts.
